title: REMAG: Recovering high-quality eukaryotic genomes from complex metagenomes
description:
REMAG recovers eukaryotic metagenome-assembled genomes from mixed prokaryotic-eukaryotic samples.

Key Features:

  • Dual-model HyenaDNA filtering of non-eukaryotic contigs
  • Contrastive embeddings learned from sequence composition and coverage
  • Greedy Leiden clustering across multiple resolutions
  • Core-gene analysis with miniprot
  • Coverage-, composition-, and core-gene-aware bin rescue
